default.description: Default capability for the WorkHub main shell and Cuu pet window.

workbench.description: R12 workbench window: deep-link events plus its own hide/minimize/drag chrome (frameless glass), plus isFocused() for the interrupt-broadcast bubble-routing decision (G-desktop stop-the-bleeding batch 4). Scoped to the workbench window only so main/pet ACLs stay unchanged.
